descriptionChirho: Physical nakedness, especially in the idiom 'uncover the nakedness of' denoting illicit sexual relations (Lev 18-20) or literal bodily exposure.
The physical private parts or genital area of the body, the bodily region that must be covered (Exod 28:42; Ezek 16:36-37).
Figurative extension meaning shame, disgrace, or vulnerability — as in 'the nakedness of the land' (Gen 42:9,12) or 'indecent thing' (Deut 24:1).
